name: phd-below-60000-cap
description: DGS 2026-09-09: a rules-sheet cell saying a course may count toward the Ph.D. is a permission, not an exemption from §4.2's other limits. A 40000-level and a 50000-level course the sheet permits draw on the SAME six credits, and the fourth such course is over the cap. (An unlisted 50000-level course still counts nothing — decision Q19; the permission has to be in the sheet.)

detailIncludes: 6 of the 6 credits below the 60000 level used
CSE 40567: 3 credits not counted — over the cap
